status: Frozen at pre-registration, before any P10 run. A change is a new version (1.1) reported beside 1.0; 1.0 is never replaced.
conventions: C-1 Mileage (rule 1): allowed = min(claimed, km x 0.30).
C-2 Meals (rule 2): allowed = min(claimed, 25.00) when travel_hours > 6, otherwise 0.00. Exactly 6 hours does not exceed 6.
C-3 Hotel (rule 3): allowed = min(claimed, 90.00 x nights) when receipt is true, otherwise 0.00 (same reading as the dev label for a 5-hour meal day, fixtures/make_cases.py:33-34).
C-4 Late claim (rule 4): if submitted minus trip_last_day is more than 30 days, every item is 0.00 and the decision is rejected. The deadline rule takes precedence over the item rules.

C-6 Referral (rule 6): an item that fits none of rules 1 to 5 is allowed 0.00 (the assistant approves nothing it may not decide; the treasurer decides) and the claim decision is refer_to_treasurer. The other items are assessed normally and the total is their sum.

C-7 Decision without a referral: approved if total allowed equals total claimed, rejected if total allowed is 0.00, otherwise partially_approved (the same rule as check C6, docassist/checks.py:84-95).
evaluated_fields: decision, total_allowed and items (index -> allowed), compared exactly by docassist.workflow.evaluate (workflow.py:205-222). expected_rules, claimed_total, submission_days and working are not read by evaluate(); expected_rules feeds secondary metric S8 only.
